english.title: Keep / use registered trailer on a road that is incorrectly registered
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[kept]_
(B)_[used]_

a trailer, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF TRAILER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF ROAD..), that was incorrectly registered in that

(C)_[the register did not include all of the applicable information relating to the trailer as specified in regulation 4(2)(d) of the Trailer Registration Regulations 2018,]_
(D)_[the information relating to the trailer that was included in the register included incorrect information,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20 and 25 of the Trailer Registration Regulations 2018.
